column1: # CI bootstrap dependency profile for the local multirepo workspace.
# Fields: directory  remote-or-fallbacks  strategy  ref  profile
#   branch          checkout and fast-forward the named remote branch
#   default-branch  checkout and fast-forward the remote's advertised HEAD
#   latest-tag      checkout detached at the newest remote tag commit
#   all             dependency used by every Python profile
#   py2             dependency used only with Python 2.x
# openerp_som_addons checkout itself is intentionally omitted: it is the
# feature worktree being prepared, not a shared dependency.
# ERP prefers the local `some` remote because it points to Som-Energia/erp in
# the standard workspace. A clone with that repository as `origin` can use
# The bootstrap clones this only for Python 2 environments.
